mentions.name: Home solar monitoring dashboard
mentions.description: A custom dashboard for monitoring a home rooftop solar system with battery, built on locally scraped data from the solar setup and served from the author's homelab machine.
mentions.problem: The bundled solar system app is only okay for answering most questions, prompting a self-built alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: But that wont prevent me from shipping my own dashboard based on locally scraped data. Just for the sake of it. Also my homelab machine is bored.
